enthalpy-diagram-pair.alt: Two energy diagrams, enthalpy on the vertical axis and progress of the reaction on the horizontal axis. Exothermic: products lower than reactants, ΔH arrow points down, ΔH < 0. Endothermic: products higher than reactants, ΔH arrow points up, ΔH > 0. In both, the hump above the reactants is the activation energy, Ea.
